use_cases: Content sections that require smooth animated transitions between views
Dashboard navigation with customizable tab items and icons
Feature comparisons with color-coded tab states
Settings or configuration pages with grouped content panels
Product showcases with animated waveform decorative elements
ai_summary: A smooth tab navigation component with animated SVG waveform decorations and fluid motion transitions. Supports custom icons, descriptions, color customization, and multiple content types per tab. Uses motion/react for orchestrated animations including waveform x-translation and opacity fades, creating an engaging interactive tab-switching experience suitable for dashboards, settings pages, and content-heavy interfaces.
